**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-cap obligation on us:

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," with fees payable only for Services ordered under an executed Order Form, and an express statement that declining to place a further Order Form "is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — bars Vendor from imposing any platform, support, administration or **minimum-use** charge not identified in the Order Form.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** — Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity, MFC, **minimum-volume** or no-hire commitment.

Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and volume language surfaced nothing adverse (remaining hits are the security-standards floor in § 17.1 and the severability wording in § 30.3, both unrelated). No redline proposed.
